Q: How do you decide whether an ADK agent change improved behavior rather than a benchmark script?
spoken: Pin the SDK and task configuration, freeze an evaluation dataset and inspect actual tool/effect traces as well as final answers. Include denied, interrupted and unsupported cases. Distinguish framework-managed state from durable application authority, and use the current SDK’s documented criterion contract rather than assuming a metric name guarantees correctness.
